# Synthetic verification only

These inputs are not project evidence, EPDs or representative building data.
They map one existing heat-pump lifecycle component to an artificial 1000 kg
BoQ line, a 100 km road route, a transport factor of 0.1 kgCO2e/tonne-km and a
product factor of 2.5 kgCO2e/kg. Expected initial A4 is 10 kgCO2e per future;
initial product and each replacement product consequence are 2500 kgCO2e.

The fixture is intentionally outside `inputs/`. It exercises nonempty carbon
parity and horizon invariance through the reproducible M2.2 audit script.
